# Syndiqo Towers

Syndiqo Towers is an interactive 3D apartment marketplace published by Syndiqo. It lets visitors switch among four procedural WebGL towers, explore planted grounds with people and a dog walker, inspect three façades on each building, and compare 48 illustrative residences by price, floor, bedrooms, area, orientation, view, floor plan, and release status.

## Canonical URLs

- Experience: https://tower.syndiqo.ma/
- Syndiqo: https://syndiqo.ma/
- HOET Technologies: https://hoet.ma/

## Important facts

- The towers, apartments, availability, property prices, and bid activity are illustrative demo content.
- The real-time models are rendered with Three.js and React Three Fiber; they are not videos.
- Apartment prices are displayed in Moroccan dirhams and change with the selected tower.
- The read-only bid terminal never submits a property order.
- A separate $29 digital buyer pack and one-apartment brand claim is sold through a secure Polar checkout.
- A successful buyer can claim one available demo residence with an organization name, website, brand color, and logo.
- Customer logos are kept in a private Cloudflare R2 bucket and served through the application.
- Syndiqo owns the Atlas Court 4B showcase residence and HOET Technologies owns Marina Fold 5A.
- Buying the digital pack does not sell or reserve real property.
